title: Lone Star Law
description:
S06 E08 — Shrimp and Run
A shrimp boat tries to make a run for it; one warden makes some furry friends; a simple trespass warning turns into a trip to jail; a warden helps a woman spiraling out of control.

title: Lone Star Law
description:
S06 E06 — Calm After the Storm
Eddins helps a neighbor in need; Reneau responds to a call about a baby red-tailed hawk; Richards attempts to serve an arrest warrant; Startz patrols solo on the Guadalupe River; wardens monitor the Rio Grande.

title: Lone Star Law
description:
S06 E03 — In Hot Water
Dockery responds to a call about an alligator found near a residential area; game wardens find blood in a hunter's car after the hunter claimed he didn't shoot anything; Boone follows up on a call about five raccoons in someone's home.

title: Lone Star Law
description:
S06 E04 — Trashed
In East Texas a young woman is served an arrest warrant; a fisherman has no fishing license but plenty of outstanding warrants; outside Austin, someone illegally dumps a pile of trash.

title: Lone Star Law
description:
S06 E07 — Midnight Manhunt
A badly injured tortoise needs an innovative procedure; an eagle's death is investigated; out on the lake, wardens educate the public on staying safe; as night falls, a car crash turns into a manhunt.

title: Lone Star Law
description:
S06 E05 — Deadly Conduct
Inman and Eddins assist on a manhunt when a suspect runs a constable off the road; an ordinary fishing check in Navarro County leads Amundson to illegal activity; in Jasper County, game wardens patrol an area after receiving trespassing complaints.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S02 E05 — Felon Hunter
Wildlife agents interrogate a felon caught hunting with a firearm; witnesses report a hunter trying to bludgeon a swimming deer from his boat; a duck shot out of season leads agents to a slew of violations.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S02 E08 — Hail of Gunfire
A barrage of heavy gunfire in an archery-only area puts wildlife agents on high alert; two boaters are stranded on Catahoula Lake; a hunter is caught in an act of fraud; a veteran agent encounters a high-stakes violation on his final patrol.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S02 E04 — Fowl Play
LDWF biologists undertake an explosive mission to help conserve Louisiana's wild turkeys; a suspicious deer skull points to a hunter flouting the law; more than 1,000 lbs of shrimp are at stake when a captain is caught in a major violation.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S02 E01 — Hunting the Hunter
When an elderly man goes missing in a vast wilderness area, wildlife agents race to find him before nightfall; a tip leads agents to a haul of undersized redfish and anglers who refuse to confess; bloody evidence ties a trespasser to an illegal deer.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S03 E07 — Backroads Outlaw
A suspicious driver leads wildlife agents on a high-speed chase through a national forest; goose-hunting guides are caught in a repeat offense; a routine stop turns treacherous when a suspect is discovered concealing a firearm.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S03 E01 — Black Market Butchers
A suspicious encounter in a quiet neighborhood leads wildlife agents to a black market venison sale. A routine boating check ends with a wanted man in handcuffs, and agents launch a massive search for a 93-year-old boater lost.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S03 E04 — Spotlight Killers
When a pair of illegal hunters flee by truck, wildlife agents set out to track them down; heaps of trash dumped at a fishing spot lead to a suspect who denies any wrongdoing; damning evidence in a truck bed catches a hunter in a lie.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S03 E02 — Stalking Bears
LDWF biologists on a conservation mission get hands-on with black bear cubs, facing a protective mama bear; hunters get caught using a banned method to hunt ducks; wildlife agents stake out after dark for a felon with an illegal gun.

title: Louisiana Law
description:
S03 E08 — Concealed in a Cooler
A bizarre discovery inside an abandoned cooler escalates a littering probe; wildlife agents patrolling in dense fog are thrown into a dangerous encounter, and a burglary investigation uncovers an illegally taken deer.

title: Amanda to the Rescue
description:
S02 E05 — One-Eyed Rottweiler
Amanda travels to California to pick up special needs dogs at a local SPCA; she comes home with a Rottweiler puppy with a severe eye injury, a husky shepherd mix covered in maggots and two small puppies whose ears have fallen off.

title: Amanda to the Rescue
description:
S02 E06 — It's Raining Cats!
Felines take over when Amanda helps an energetic kitten facing euthanasia after breaking his leg for a second time, along with a tiny kitten born with malformed front legs; a 3-legged Husky-Rottweiler pup needs a forever home.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S06 E07 — Saving Captain Hook
Police rescue a turtle caught on fishing line, and it's up to Dr. Ross to unhook him; Dr. Blue waits for test results after performing dental surgery on a lovable dachshund; Dr. Lavigne gives a stray cat first-class treatment.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S06 E04 — Struggling Pug
Dr. Lavigne performs a doggy nose job to help a pug with bad breathing problems; Dr. Blue urgently treats Hardtime, a dog who's facing hard times battling heart disease; an opossum with a traumatic injury needs Dr. Ross's help.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S06 E01 — Houston Ink
The doctors prepare to open a new clinic but are apprehensive about a promise they made to each other regarding the event; Dr. Ross tends to a frizzle hen's eye problem; Dr. Blue is alarmed by a bulldog's burst mammary gland.

title: The Vet Life
description:
S06 E03 — Operation Opera
A chicken is rushed to Dr. Ross after being attacked by a coyote; a Great Dane mix has a seizure; Dr. Lavigne uncovers multiple issues; a surprise serenade at the clinic musically inspires Dr. Blue.

title: My Cat From Hell
description:
S02 E02 — Mad Max
City the Kitty is a Bengal cat with jungle energy who is disrupting the peace between his keepers; Mad Max sneaks into his owners' neighbor's apartment and is too dangerous to be around their soon-to-be-born baby.

title: My Cat From Hell
description:
S02 E04 — Pissed Off!
Jackson must find space for a vicious cat named Stella who is preventing her owners from expanding their family.

title: My Cat From Hell
description:
S02 E01 — Terrorizing My Clients
A female cat named Larry with disturbing bouts of aggression threatens to keep her owners from getting married; an aggressive cat named Ruby ruins her keepers in-home Pilates studio and threatens their thriving livelihood.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S10 E06 — Baked Alaskan
A deadly spider bite puts Gwen at risk, but she works with her partner to get her revenge in the 130-degree heat of the Mexican jungle.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S10 E09 — The Spirits Are Angry
A haunted Colombian rainforest punishes the survivalists with threats from deadly jaguars, 300 species of snakes and relentless biting insects; the challenge is threatened when the survivalists don't heed the curse of the jungle.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S10 E13 — What the Duck?
In Mexico, two fan survivalists are dropped on an unforgiving, cenote-covered island filled with venomous coral snakes, territorial jaguars, blood-sucking chiquistas, and a duck named Henry that they desperately want to eat for dinner.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S10 E15 — Don't Let the Jungle Bugs Bite
Avoiding the dangers of a rushing river, two survivalists brave a vast cave system in the Colombian rainforest; trying to survive 21 days, the jungle tests them with threats including venomous fer-de-lance snakes, piranhas and biting insects.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S10 E03 — You've Got Another Sting Coming
On a sun-scorched Brazilian island, aggressive anaconda and deadly stingray torment survivalists Whitney and Nathan, pushing both of them to their breaking point; working together they use their hunting and fishing skills to try and make it 21 days.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S14 E05 — Night Stalkers
A wilderness guide and a software engineer diagnosed with Asperger's try to survive in the Botswana desert; herds of aggressive elephants threaten their security at night, but their biggest hurdle is learning to communicate with each other.

title: Naked and Afraid
description:
S12 E03 — The Devil's Woods
The frigid Montana wilderness pushes the survivalists' partnership over the edge; they struggle to work together; wildlife including bears and aggressive moose circle their camp; plummeting temperatures create the need for drastic action.

title: Amanda to the Rescue
description:
Pit-Bull and Panda
Amanda works with Tia of Pit Bulls & Parolees to rescue a 3-legged Shepherd mix as part of a road trip rescue mission; she picks up 16 dogs along the way, including a young lab with a brain issue and a puppy mill survivor.

title: Amanda to the Rescue
description:
S02 E08
A member of Amanda's crew wants to adopt a Frenchie who lived her entire life in a puppy mill; Cupid, a lab mix puppy, needs daily physical therapy for a brain disorder; a pittie from Amanda's past needs emergency surgery.

title: Extinct or Alive
description:
S02 E11 — The Caribbean Monk Seal
Forest sets off on a dangerous, shark-infested search for the extinct Caribbean monk seal, to prove its existence, he and the crew descend into deep waters where they come face-to-face with a giant tiger shark.

title: Extinct or Alive
description:
S02 E17 — Southern Rocky Mountain Wolf
The southern Rocky Mountain wolf hasn't been seen in almost 80 years, but recent cattle attacks spark the possibility that is still exists; trekking high into the Sierras, Forrest is determined to bring it out of hiding.

title: Extinct or Alive
description:
S02 E09 — The Dracula Monkey of Borneo
Forrest returns to the volcanic islands of Indonesia to find the Millers grizzled langur, otherwise known as the Dracula monkey.

title: Swamp Wars
description:
S03 E04 — Rattlesnake in My Car
A rattlesnake takes a dip in a pool, while another hides out in a woman's car; Capt. Seifert encounters a blood python.

title: Swamp Wars
description:
S01 E02 — Cannibal Gator
Gators turn up everywhere, from backyard pools to bathrooms.

title: Swamp Wars
description:
S01 E05 — Snake Farm Shootout
A snake farm is taken hostage, and it is feared the snakes may be unleashed into the suburbs.

title: Swamp Wars
description:
S01 E03 — Gator vs. Python
After a python eats a gator, many theories about the battle are developed. African Rock pythons are becoming a problem in the suburbs of Miami.

title: River Monsters
description:
S07 E02 — Mekong Mutilator
Jeremy Wade is lured to the shores of the Mekong River in Cambodia to search for a monstrous fish that has mauled, blinded, killed and most recently sliced clean through a young man's testicle.

title: River Monsters
description:
S07 E06 — Africa's Deadliest
Jeremy Wade returns to the Okavango Delta to re-investigate a predatory carnivore that may have mauled over 100 victims of a capsized boat; to discover the truth, Jeremy offers himself up as live bait.

title: River Monsters
description:
S09 E06 — Malaysian Lake Monster
After two men vanish from a remote lake in Malaysia, Jeremy sets out to find the possible culprit; a trail of evidence leads Jeremy into an ancient rainforest, where an old adversary lies in wait.

title: River Monsters
description:
S09 E02 — Ice Cold Killer
Traveling from London to Greenland and on to Norway, Wade follows the trail of an unknown sea monster; fishing through ice to extreme depths, he attempts to reel in this monster before the full fury of an Arctic storm hits.

title: River Monsters
description:
S09 E05 — Volcanic Island Terror
On a volcanic island in the Pacific, terror grips a fishing community when something in the water leaves a trail of bloody victims in its wake; the only clues they have to the attacker's identity are the large puncture wounds it left behind.

title: River Monsters
description:
S09 E03 — Coral Reef Killer
On the tropical island of Sulawesi, Indonesia, a tourist snorkeler and several local fishermen have been killed and injured by a mysterious sea creature that impales its victims; Wade travels to the scene to investigate.

title: River Monsters
description:
Killers From the Abyss
Wade takes on the biggest investigation of his career -- to unravel what happened to over 1,000 passengers of the RMS Laconia, torpedoed in the mid-Atlantic; he travels the globe, battling giant fish, massive sharks and a deep-sea monster.

title: River Monsters
description:
S09 E04 — Return of the Killer Catfish
Jeremy Wade investigates a case in Nepal that sounds strangely familiar -- a lone fisherman dragged off his feet and into a mountain river by the original river monster, the goonch catfish.

title: Amanda to the Rescue
description:
S02 E09 — All Paws on Deck
Amanda faces one of her most challenging rescues when a puppy arrives with serious neurological issues; Panda Paws helps a Chihuahua terrier mix bounce back after only having the use of one leg before finding him a forever family.

title: Amanda to the Rescue
description:
S02 E10 — Frenchie Fix
Amanda teams up again with Tia of "Pit Bulls and Parolees" to help Aiden, a Great Dane mix with a brain issue; she meets Chickpea, a French bulldog with a medical condition that quickly turns into a life or death situation.

title: The Aquarium
description:
S02 E02 — Sea Otter Summer Camp
The team is determined to have Gibson the sea otter pup discover his independence as he separates from his pal, Mara; the African penguins head off-site for spring-cleaning; Thor the moray eel proves he's the ultimate escape artist.

title: The Aquarium
description:
S02 E05 — Big Momma's Surprise
A sea lion called Finn has tummy trouble and the team feeds him a snack that will help them investigate why; Big Mama, the guitarfish, may be living up to her name; the boa-duo, Ripley and Ridley, receive a new home.

title: The Aquarium
description:
S02 E07 — Maggie the Magnificent
Technology is brought to the aquarium to monitor beluga whale activity; Maggie the small-clawed otter's training kicks in when receiving a shot and Morty the sea star has a checkup after suspicious growths form.

title: Tanked
description:
S03 E06 — On the Road Again
Brett and Wayde reflect on their unusual experiences building tanks across America.

title: Tanked
description:
S04 E02 — Learn to Love or Love to Learn
A Las Vegas wedding business wants a tank that reflects the city's early flavor; the team struggles to install a giant tank in a new student common area at Saint Leo University.

title: Tanked
description:
S03 E07 — Midwest Zest
A children's hospital in Detroit desires a treasure-chest tank; Heather and Agnes assume new roles; a leasing company wants a homey tank.

title: Tanked
description:
S03 E05 — Love Is an Illusion
Neil Patrick Harris wants a tank based on Houdini's famous water escape; Wayde has plans for his 15-year wedding anniversary.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S04 E04 — Treehive Beehive
Pete and his team undertake a sticky challenge and reinvent the classic single-tree treehouse; constructing a magnificent and whimsical beehive-like structure soaring 30-feet high in a majestic Douglas fir.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S04 E03 — Meditating Maple
The NTS team focus their chi to create a meditation space 20 feet high through twisting maples for a couple in West Seattle.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S04 E02 — The Coolest Treehouse Ever Built
Pete takes on an exciting project for two tastemakers in Maine that includes a towering rooftop crow's nest and a wall of windows.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S04 E06 — Kentucky Climber's Cottage
In Kentucky, Pete creates a treehouse with 17-foot-high ceilings and open-frame timber rafters, allowing a couple with a love of tree-climbing to harness up and dangle from both inside and out.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S04 E01 — Treetop Candy Kitchen
A 500 square-foot ski lodge treehouse with a stainless steel candy kitchen and wine bar, 11 feet in the air and among 14 camphor trees is the gift Santa Pete wants to give the candy and wine making Splinter family of Northern California.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S05 E03 — Mindbending Silver Maple
Pete finds inspiration in old tales to build a mesmerizing treehouse, with a curved turret that soars two stories high and a deck to take in the amazing sights, over the stems of a twisty silver maple on the shore of Lake Chelan.

title: Treehouse Masters
description:
S05 E01 — Nelson Family Treehouse
Pete Nelson uproots an existing treehouse from the family-owned bed & breakfast Treehouse Point to build a custom-made treehouse as a housewarming gift for his daughter, Emily.
